description: Add your own GitHub repos or direct download links here. A = download, X = remove, Y = edit. On every start the app checks whether the repos you added have new versions.
empty: No links yet. Add your first link below.
editor_help: Link to a GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/repo) or to a file. For a repo the newest release is always downloaded. Pick the kind of download - the matching folders are filled in and can be changed.
field_filter_desc: Only use files whose name contains this text. Useful when a release has several downloads.
remove_confirm: Remove "{}" from the list? Files that were already downloaded stay on the SD card.
updates_notify: {} update(s) available for your custom links
cfw_info: This CFW pack appears under "Update Atmosphère". Press X to remove it from the list.
err_invalid_url: That is not a valid link. Use a GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/repo) or a link starting with http:// or https://.
err_invalid_path:
Invalid folder: {}
Use paths like /switch/ or /themes/ (no "..").
err_duplicate: This link already exists with the same name.
err_network: Cannot reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.
err_rate_limit: GitHub is not allowing more requests right now (rate limit). Try again later.
err_no_release: No release was found for this repo. The link must point to a repo with published releases.
err_no_assets: The newest release has no files to download.
err_no_match: No matching file was found in the newest release. Check the kind of download, the "Extract" option, or set a file filter.
err_not_zip: The downloaded file is not a ZIP archive and cannot be extracted. Set "Extract" to "No" or choose another file.
err_unknown: The link could not be resolved.
